svg.text: USG (7× RJ45) · MikroTik CRS305 (4× 10G + mgmt) · 2× Flex Mini 2.5G (USB-C power keystones, red) · 12/12 keystone panels
PANEL A (U3) — Flex Minis: data 1–8, USB-C power 9–10 (red)
USB-C power keystones (RED) — fed from UPS
A1 ↔ B9 Flex Mini #1 uplink ↔ MikroTik 10G1
A5 ↔ B10 Flex Mini #2 uplink ↔ MikroTik 10G2
B8 ↔ B4 MikroTik mgmt ↔ USG LAN
22 of 24 slots used (A: 10/12, B: 12/12) · 2 spare on Panel A · 12 optional holes on NUC fascias (3×2 each, dashed grey)
